title: Trepang2
provenance: Reported by Swiss-Mac-User (highball-db#1120, 2026-11-09), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.3, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r29, DXMT by the report (the environment's mode is DXVK), rated 5 of 5 after 46 minutes: about a minute until the intro loads, then flawless at 2560x1440 on Epic settings. DXMT is a must, DXVK shows a black screen with only a few coloured lines (screenshot). The DXVK log pasted in the report is Steam's web helper's (its Game line), not the game's. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on an M5 Pro with DXMT on the Wine 11 engine r29 at 2560x1440 on Epic settings. Use DXMT: DXVK shows a black screen.
